content: Wu-Tang’s Once Upon A Time in Shaolin album has, for the most part, been extremely difficult to listen to, but you can now hear two snippets of the album thanks to the podcast Pablo Torre Finds Out, which just published an episode all about the exclusive record. Once Upon A Time in Shaolin has a long history, which Pablo Torre Finds Out goes into in detail. Disgraced pharmaceutical executive Martin Shkreli bought the only copy of the album, which cannot be commercially released until 2103, in 2015 at auction. Shkreli had to forfeit the album to the US government, and the government sold it in 2021 to the crypto art collective PleasrDAO, which has allowed it to be played at special exhibitions. Pablo Torre Finds Out, working with PleasrDAO, hosted a listening party for the album where they played it for Wu-Tang Clan member Method Man, who had never heard it up until that point. The podcast recorded the event and Method Man’s reaction, and you can hear two snippets from the album at 32:30 and 39:02 during the show. Method Man’s review? “I do not hate this album.”

chineseContent: Wu-Tang 的《少林往事》专辑在很大程度上都非常难听，但由于播客 Pablo Torre Finds Out，你现在可以听到专辑的两个片段，该播客刚刚发布了有关该独家唱片的一集。 《少林往事》有着悠久的历史，巴勃罗·托雷的《发现》对此进行了详细介绍。名誉扫地的制药公司高管马丁·施克雷利 (Martin Shkreli) 在 2015 年的拍卖会上买下了这张专辑的唯一副本，该专辑直到 2103 年才得以商业发行。 Shkreli 不得不将这张专辑交给美国政府，政府于 2021 年将其出售给加密艺术团体 PleasrDAO，该团体允许该专辑在特别展览中播放。 Pablo Torre Finds Out 与 PleasrDAO 合作，为这张专辑举办了一场聆听派对，并为 Wu-Tang Clan 成员 Method Man 播放了这张专辑，而 Method Man 此前从未听过这张专辑。播客记录了该事件和 Method Man 的反应，您可以在节目期间的 32:30 和 39:02 听到专辑中的两个片段。方法人的评论？ “我不讨厌这张专辑。”
